correctness.rationale: Differentiated geometric series yields exact survival T_K=p^K(K+n)/n for p=(n-1)/n and m=2n-2. Endpoint alpha_1>0 (four rational base checks then monotonic (1+1/x)^x) and alpha_m<0 for n>=3 (two base checks then e<3). With a_k=(k+1)p^k/n^2, ratio beta_i=a_(m+i)/a_(m-i) obeys sign(beta_(i+1)/beta_i-1)=sign((2n-1)(i(i+1)-2n(n-1))). It falls then rises and crosses 1 at most once, so alpha_i first decreases then possibly increases and can cross zero only once. Independent exact Fraction checks n=2,3,4,5,6,10,30 corroborate signs, not infinite proof; symbolic cancellation independently verifies the ratio polynomial.
